name: resume-after-interrupt-initial
description: First half of the resume-after-interrupt pair (F1/F3): the initial attempt crashes mid-run after establishing a sessionRef. A runtime test drives start() with this scenario (via engineConfig.scenarioName), observes the abnormal stream end, marks the run interrupted, then drives resume({sessionRef}) with resume-after-interrupt-continuation.json to prove the session carries across the crash.
